tersanctus.definition:
n. An ancient ascription of praise (containing the word
   "Holy" -- in its Latin form, "Sanctus" -- thrice repeated), used in the
   Mass of the Roman Catholic Church and before the prayer of consecration
   in the communion service of the Church of England and the Protestant
   Episcopal Church. Cf. Trisagion.
